Temporal Relations

An extension of loze.ttl with relations for locating eventualities relative to periods of time

https://loze-ontology.org/temporal-relations

8 terms
Property

after Time

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e occurs entirely after t

Property

at Time

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e is the case or is occurring at t

Property

before Time

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e occurs entirely before t

Property

from Time

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e starts occurring at t

Property

is Sub-Period Of

The relation that obtains between two periods of time of which the former is a part or segment of the latter

Property

throughout Time

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period t if and only if e occurs starting from the beginning of t until and until the end of

Property

until Time

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e ends at t

Property

within Time

The relation that obtains betwen an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e occurs throughout a a sub-period of t
